oracle_basis: Orim's Chant targets one player; Silence restricts all opponents.
Ranger-Captain's resolved sacrifice ability restricts opponents' noncreature spells, not creature spells.
Voice of Victory restricts opponents from casting spells during its controller's turn.
Thassa's Oracle uses an ETB trigger that survives source removal.
Underworld Breach escape requires exiling three other graveyard cards per escape.
Brain Freeze storm counts spells cast before it; copies are not cast.
Mindbreak Trap's free condition requires one opponent to have cast three or more spells that turn.
invariants: Oracle and Breach are evaluated as separate terminal families
no graveyard card is exiled twice for escape
storm count tracks casts, not copies
countering a storm trigger does not erase the original Brain Freeze
one Tidebinder storm-trigger answer is not labeled terminal if Breach can legally rebuild
resolved Ranger does not illegally prohibit creature answers
resolved Silence/Voice restrictions are applied to creature answers as appropriate
